baselines.why: Nightly tests moved to a new test machine (a Mac, running each install in a Docker sandbox) with newer releases of all 5 agents.
baselines.caveat: the new sandbox image was also missing uvx, the tool that starts Python MCP servers. So MCP time, MCP fetch, MCP git and claimidx (20 installs across all 5 agents) failed on Nov 12 and 13 for our reason, not theirs. All 20 passed on Nov 8. Treat those 4 as untested until the next run on the fixed image.
